not_verifiable: The chart is an undated internal quality-management sheet that can change at any time; its Delivery/Takeaway sheet (gid 0) prints different calories for some of the same dishes (Garlic Sharing Bread 759 vs 794 here) and was not read. Ingredient lists were used only for the contradiction and tag checks, not compared word by word. Drinks without a stated measure are published as 'per portion' exactly as the chart's heading says.
notes: Calories-only chain. Method different from the extraction script (pdftotext word positions + fixed columns): all 16 table pages were rendered to 150 dpi images and read by eye, and every published row on pages 1-16 (226 items from 193 chart rows) was compared on name, every calorie figure and size, Allergens, May Contain and the two dietary cells; page 17 (13 items) was compared with the PDF text layer (pdftotext -layout). No mismatch. Rows read include the largest (Burrata Sharing Board with Charcuterie 1079) and smallest (Salt 0, Sea Salt Flakes 0, Tabasco 0.5) values, every size row (gelato scoops, wine glass sizes, spirit single/double, limoncello 125ml) and the cell with a hyphen wrap (Add-on, Semi-Skimmed, Friuli-Venezia). Held back after reading the rendered page (5 chart rows, 9 items): Hackney Gelato Alphonso Mango Sorbetto (Allergens None and vegan, but its ingredient list ends with a wafer printed WHEAT, SOYA, MILK), Egg Fusilli with Tuscan-Style Sausage & Fennel Ragu (Allergens cell ends with a dangling comma), Hackney Gelato Strawberry Clotted Cream (May Contain cell ends with a dangling comma), Pinot Grigio Franz Haas (125ml 95 kcal is 0.76 kcal/ml while 175ml 119 and 250ml 170 are 0.68 for both), Kocktail Amaretto Sour (ingredient Lazzaroni Amaretto, Allergens None). Left out (11 rows): two waters printing N/A, Espresso and Macchiato printing one figure for 'single/double', two draught beers with no measure (Poretti Draft 48 kcal is about 100 ml of beer), five retail jars/grinders whose weight in the name cannot match the figure. Printed as is and noted: Nero d'Avola prints 1.09 kcal per ml at all three sizes (the other wines 0.69-0.96); the chart's spellings Fomaggi, Calamary, Chioccolato, Kocktail, 'Containig' are kept.
